investigation_notes.Description: PowerShell was invoked in a hidden window by winword.exe, with a parent process outlook.exe, to run a command that establishes a TCP connection to 45.33.19.121:443 and attempts to read/write data in a loop. The script uses iex to execute decoded content, a common obfuscation pattern for remote code execution. While the initiating Word process has no known malicious reputation and no prior similar alerts were found, the combination of hidden PowerShell activity, direct external C2 contact, and a non-standard process lineage is suspicious and warrants HP triage.
